description: CLK2 (carrier about 145 MHz, 3rd harmonic wanted) through an unidentified SAW filter and a 10 dB attenuator

chain.name: SAW filter
chain.notes: wide passband, about 421-444 MHz at -3 dB (measured 2026-10-31)

chain.name: attenuator
chain.notes: in front of the analyser; marked 10 dB, measured 25.8 dB at 435 MHz

notes: The Si5351 output goes straight into the SAW. Levels in the results are as read by the analyser; pad_db is added back to get the level leaving the filter. The attenuator is marked 10 dB but measured 25.8 dB at 435 MHz (2026-10-31), so pad_db is 25.8.
